stem: For the linear function \(f\), \(f(1) + f(2) + f(3) + \cdots + f(9) = 117\) and \(f(9) - f(1) = 16\). What is the value of \(f(7)\)?
solution: For a linear function, the values at equally spaced inputs are symmetric about the middle input, so the mean of \(f(1), \ldots, f(9)\) is \(f(5)\): \(f(5) = \frac{117}{9} = 13\).
verify:
x, m, b = symbols('x m b')
f = lambda u: m*u + b
sol = solve([sum(f(i) for i in range(1, 10)) - 117, f(9) - f(1) - 16], [m, b], dict=True)
assert sol == [{m: 2, b: 3}]
ans = f(7).subs(sol[0])
assert ans == 17 and spr_answers == [str(ans)]
